details.answer: The premise of your question is incorrect according to the course curriculum: useCallback prevents child component re-renders without wrapping the child in React.memo is false. useCallback memoizes function references between renders. However, child components still re-render when the parent re-renders unless the child component is explicitly wrapped in React.memo. [React Hooks Tutorial - Chunk 4]
